title: Cloud worker re-prompts a harness that ends its turn with no report, and runs claude with background tasks off
description: PR #78 (2026-09-27) made the local subprocess executor re-prompt a runner that exits 0 with no report (claude --resume / pi --session-id, at most twice) and launch claude with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1. image/worker.sh runs pi -p / claude -p once with no fallback, so a cloud worker that ends its turn early (the vqc resolve-50 stall: 'The gate is still running. I'll wait for its completion notification.' then exit 0) is missing-result immediately. Port both to worker.sh once ticfac owns image/ (r6w). Also add the prompt lines from #77/#78 (never amend/rebase pushed commits; you run headless, never end your turn waiting on a background task) to tk sandbox worker-prompt or its ticfac replacement.
acceptance_criteria: A cloud worker whose harness exits 0 without a report is re-prompted in the same session up to twice before missing-result; a test in image/ or the sandbox harness covers it
